content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble with my [product_name]. 1- When I unplug the LAN cable, the display shows an error message: "Urgent Event / Network Error ... check cable" 2- I can't save anything in the "Text message" block. After I type, the text disappears as soon as I close the block window. Any advice would be appreciated.
Apologies, but I don't quite understand your issue. Are you trying to generate a custom message when a network error happens?

1- Disconnecting the LAN cable makes the [product_name] display the "Urgent Event / Network Error ... check cable" message, which is standard from [company_name]. A missing or broken network cable will trigger this notification. 2- For saving text in the "Text message" block, don't simply close the window—make sure to click OK or APPLY at the bottom of the block properties. Closing without confirming will erase your changes.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience automatic network error messages when disconnecting the LAN cable, which is seen as a normal system reaction. There are also usability issues with saving custom text in configuration blocks: unclear confirmation buttons can result in text being lost if users close the window directly. More prominent and intuitive feedback for confirming text inputs in the software interface is needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear indicators for network errors and a user-friendly process for saving custom text within configuration blocks in the software.
